output.reason: The proposed condition is both too broad and too narrow, but the evidence does not support a precise replacement. [ev-01e97dc9c4df] limits the impact to mutate/generate policies "on custom resources" that the controller can no longer view, and to reports. So flagging every Policy/ClusterPolicy with a mutate or generate rule is too broad, and it misses report impact, which the render shows comes from the reports controller losing */* get/list/watch [ev-fbb2a078179b, ev-8034700c2e78, ev-0ae726bec846]. A correct exposure needs two things the excerpts do not give: what the default `view` binding still covers (the Role Based Access Controls documentation section it points to), and the Helm values file that keeps wildcard view permissions, which is the shielding overlap mentioned in [ev-2bbc505de6bb] but not shown.
